simple.meaning: to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לָהַהּ (H3856) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: לָהַהּ (lâhahh) means to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish First listed occurrence: Gen 47 13.

definitions.short: to be rabid (figuratively, insane); also (from the exhaustion of frenzy) to languish
definitions.full: H3856. lahah [ לָהָה ] verb languish, faint (= לָאָה ) ( לְהִי ᵑ7 , id. ; — Qal Imperfect 3feminine singular with apocope אֶרֶץ וַתֵּ֫לַהּ Gen 47:13 (of famine). [ לִהְלֵהַּ ] verb quadriliteral amaze, startle (compare Syriac Palpel confudit, obstupefecit ; Ethpalpel stupore percussus est ; consternatio , all in Lexicons, PS 1894 ) — Hithpalpel Participle מִתְלַהְלֵהַּ as substantive = madman , followed by זִקִים הַיֹּרֶה Prov Gen 26:18 (see Now).
